person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and narrates multiple characters in third person. The authorized opening establishes sustained third-person limited scene narration, Jenkins's structural account explains that later Left Behind books alternate focal characters while remaining in third person, and a scholarly source reproduces matching narration from pages 211–212. The two event quotes are locally consistent but remain unmarked because each is too short to establish narrator participation independently; the other quotes are speech or embedded scripture. No credible source indicates first-, second-, epistolary, or mixed-person base sections. The only minor limitation is that Jenkins discusses later Left Behind titles collectively rather than naming this volume in the structural statement, but the title-specific opening and interior evidence independently align.
